caption: The drawing depicts an octagonal plate with a tan or beige background, featuring a symmetrical design composed of stylized tulip-like floral motifs in shades of reddish-brown, rust, and dark brown. The central motif is the largest, with an elongated teardrop shape, flanked on either side by slightly smaller, similarly patterned floral elements. Each floral form is filled with alternating segments of reddish-brown and dark brown, separated by lighter or unpainted lines. Surrounding the central motif, there are additional smaller floral forms, one in each corner of the plate, also rendered in reddish-brown and dark brown tones with a similar segmented appearance. Curved lines resembling stems and leaves in a reddish-brown color connect the floral patterns, extending outward from the base and curling around each floral shape. At the bottom of the plate, a triangular section contains a series of wavy lines and small arches in reddish-brown. The plate itself is outlined with a thin, scalloped reddish-brown border. The background behind the plate is filled with a light, muted blue or teal color, which helps the plate stand out prominently. The artist's signature appears in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Pa. German Plate
